svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bought box with four moulded corner pillars for the lid screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor, measured from its centre, front is away from the gland:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 4.5 mm holes 40 mm each side along, 20 mm each side across;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 3.5 mm holes 7 mm each side of centre, 5 mm to the right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The floor holes must match the plate's tapped holes: drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them through the plate's holes with the box clamped on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear end wall: one 16.2 mm hole for the M16 gland, 10 mm left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre, its centre 20 mm up from the box's underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front end wall: one 12.2 mm hole for the M12 breather vent,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the centre line, its centre 30 mm up from the underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the faces, pilot 3 mm at low speed with wood behind, open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out with a step drill. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the floor sits flat on the plate; a ring of neutral-cure

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: silicone round each floor hole underneath seals it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no crack runs from any hole under a bright lamp.
